Name: Codex Micro · Aurora
Overview: Aurora Silk animations for 13 Codex conversations, with live allowance and AI status on the Ulanzi D200H long panel.
Description:
OpenCodexMicro · Aurora turns the Ulanzi D200H into a dedicated Codex Desktop control surface with Aurora Silk motion and a readable live overview.

FEATURES
- Aurora Silk animations use consistent colors for running, waiting, unread completion, errors, and idle.
- Show real conversation titles, stable identifiers, and optional aliases stored only on this Mac.
- Opt in to remaining allowance, reset countdowns, and running/waiting/error counts on the native long panel while retaining all thirteen conversation keys. This compatibility route is verified with Studio 3.4.4 and stops on unverified versions.
- View thirteen Codex conversations with live status and open the exact selected task.
- Use Fast, Usage, Pin, New, Fork, Steer, Mic, and Submit actions.
- Use the Latest Task & Scroll Encoder action to open task 1 and scroll Codex.
- Install, repair, launch, and check Codex Bridge from every Action setup page.
- Keep communication local through Codex Bridge.app and loopback-only endpoints.

INSTALLATION ENVIRONMENT
- macOS 13 or later; tested on Apple Silicon
- Codex Desktop
- Ulanzi Studio 3.4.4 (verified compatibility version)
- Ulanzi D200H connected in Ulanzi Studio
- Node.js 20 or later only for manual repository setup

LLM / AGENT INSTALLATION
In your Agent, enter:
Install the Ulanzi Studio plugin for me: https://github.com/RickeyRen/OpenCodexMicro-Aurora#1-llm--agent-installation

MANUAL INSTALLATION
1. Clone https://github.com/RickeyRen/OpenCodexMicro-Aurora and open the repository directory.
2. Quit Ulanzi Studio.
3. Run: npm install
4. Run: npm run install:plugin
5. Run: npm run setup
6. Reopen Ulanzi Studio, quit Codex Desktop, and launch ~/Applications/Codex Bridge.app.
7. Add the Codex Micro actions to your keys in Ulanzi Studio.
8. Select any Action to check Bridge installation, service, and CDP status.
9. Optional long panel: select Pure background with no image in Studio, then run npm run setup:overview -- --enable. See the guide for profile selection and compatibility limits.

IMPORTANT
When using Codex Micro, always launch Codex through ~/Applications/Codex Bridge.app. Do not open Codex Desktop directly.
Launch command: open ~/Applications/Codex\ Bridge.app

Localization.BridgeSetupDescription: Install, launch, and check the local Codex connection.
Localization.UninstallBridgeDone: Codex Bridge was uninstalled. The Ulanzi plugin and Codex Desktop were kept.
Localization.UninstallBridgeConfirm: Uninstall Codex Bridge and its background service? The Ulanzi plugin and Codex Desktop will not be removed.
Localization.BridgeAppDescription: Codex Bridge.app is a local launcher. It refuses to start another instance while Codex is running. Save your work and quit Codex manually, then launch Codex Bridge.app to start the official Codex Desktop executable with loopback-only CDP arguments.
Localization.BridgeAppSafety: The launcher leaves the Codex Desktop app bundle on disk unchanged and limits CDP to this Mac's loopback interface. The Bridge uses CDP to read and change Codex's Micro runtime state and forward control actions.
Localization.LaunchAgentDescription: The LaunchAgent starts the local Codex Bridge service when you sign in and restarts it if it exits. The service listens only on this Mac through a loopback address.
Localization.NodeSelectionStrategy: Install / Repair first selects a system Node.js 20 or later from your login environment, PATH, Homebrew, or common install paths. It uses Ulanzi Studio's bundled Node only as a fallback.
Localization.NodeInstallRecommendation: Recommended: install the latest Node.js from Terminal, then run Install / Repair again:
Localization.UlanziNodeSignatureNotice: If the Ulanzi Studio Node fallback is used, macOS Background Items may show an activity carrying the Ulanzi Studio signature. This is the Codex Bridge service running with Ulanzi Studio's Node executable.
